meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 能搜索历次会话存下的记忆库:先返回带 ID 的简洁索引,再显示相关时间线,最后只获取你选中的完整记录。
howto.when: 当你问到之前会话的内容,例如“上次是不是解决过”“上次怎么做 X”,或需要过往工作资料时触发。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么解决登录问题的?
say.note: Claude 会搜索记忆库并列出相关记录。

say.text: 帮我找一下上周关于支付模块的笔记
say.note: 会先显示索引,再按需获取详情。

say.text: 查一下之前关于 authentication 的讨论
say.note: 会搜索并返回匹配的时间线。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude can search the persistent cross-session memory database: it returns a compact index with IDs, shows timeline context, and fetches full records only for selected entries.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user asks about previous sessions, e.g. 'did we already solve this?', 'how did we do X last time?', or needs work from earlier conversations.

say_en.text: How did we solve the login issue last time?
say_en.note: Claude will search the memory and list matching records.

say_en.text: Find my notes about the payment module from last week.
say_en.note: It shows an index first, then fetches details on demand.

say_en.text: Look up our earlier discussion about authentication.
say_en.note: It will search and return matching timeline entries.
